children: may extend gains into a range of $111.91-$112.99 per barrel, as suggested by a projection analysis.
The market has briefly pierced above $110.17, the 176.4% projection level of an uptrend from $97.11. The projection analysis suggests an extension of the uptrend towards $114.74, the 238.2% level.

Strategically, both this target and the range of $111.91-$112.99 will be confirmed when the market breaks $110.91. Support is at $109.08, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $107.34-$108.21 range.
A break below $107.34 may trigger a fall to $106.26. On the daily chart, a bullish flag pattern has been confirmed, suggesting a target around $130.

A rising channel points at a lower target of $117.80. The projection analysis on the uptrend from $78.19 reveals a resistance at $110.24, the 100% level, which is close to $110.91 (hourly chart). An extension of the uptrend towards $114.92 or $130.04 will only be confirmed when the market breaks $110.24.
